issue.title: Export-mode instruction render still lists home-only linked repos (chezmoi, '(home configuration)') in pkg.sase.repos

task_type_fields.impact: Any future public export (E4's planned instructions export/sync, or anyone publishing render -f mode=export output) would leak the owner's home-only linked repos and home config metadata.
task_type_fields.repro:
Reported in epic sase-1ko note #15 (research.1a.cdx, Finding B of
research:202610/instruction_bundles_keep_delivery_preserve_readable_contract__cdx.md,
file:explicit:8ccecece271b668ba9820e83). Reproduced by the sase-1ko land agent on 88acef6234.

    sase instructions render -f mode=export,provider=codex      # bundle text
    sase instructions render -f mode=export,provider=codex -j   # manifest

The export manifest includes no `home.*` section, but the bundle's `pkg.sase.repos` section
still lists the home-only linked repo `chezmoi` with the `(home configuration)` tag, and that
section's `sources` include the home `sase.yml` config alongside the package template and project
config.

Root cause: `src/sase/instructions/compile.py` (added in E2 commit 22ea0cf4db) always merges
`linked_entries_from_config(global_config, label="home")` into `merged_entries` before rendering
the package contract template, whatever the actor/mode. Excluding the home memory layer does not
undo that merge. Fix: when the render excludes the home layer (export mode), skip the home
linked-repo entries and drop the home config from `pkg.sase.repos` sources; add a test that an
export render contains no home-derived repo names and no home-scoped source.

issue.creation_reason: Found by research.1a.cdx while reviewing E3 (epic note #15); the leak comes from the E2 compiler, not E3, and must be fixed before any public export is published.
